notation_conventions.power_scope: Every one of the 55 msup nodes has a single variable base and exact positive integer exponent. Speak coefficient times the variable power, then the explicit end marker; never include the preceding coefficient in the power. Do not evaluate unknown letters or substitute a convenient value.
notation_conventions.multiplication: Read every actual implicit numeric-coefficient product as ping/kali, including mixed plain-text 14+italic y, 9+italic p and complete italic 5x. The explicit dot in x=1·x stays explicit; the 0.2em in a=1a remains spacing and does not erase multiplication.
notation_conventions.punctuation: Commas enumerate terms or separate source clauses, and semicolons close source reasoning clauses; they are not operations. Periods remain sentence boundaries. Narration-only sentence/line pauses make part boundaries explicit without changing visible punctuation.
notation_conventions.layouts: M10 is a one-row six-term display with ten preserved blank spacer cells, not sixteen spoken values. M56 has three centered rows; its middle row reads all twelve x terms and eleven plus signs and names the exact gaps after terms four and eleven. No ellipsis, equality, arrow or bracket is invented.

finite_source_english_differences.reason: M01 dan/and; M14/M15 Indonesian n² and 9n² versus English x² and 9x². The Indonesian values match the preceding display and are retained exactly.
